delete.description: Delete or cancel a vote (proxies to ITX DELETE /voting/poll/{poll_id}). A disabled (draft) vote is deleted. An active vote is cancelled: the vote and its responses are permanently removed, and recipients receive a cancellation notice; response cleanup runs asynchronously. Ended votes, whether closed early, closed automatically or past end_time, cannot be deleted; ITX returns 400 'ended polls cannot be deleted'. Requires writer on the vote.

comment_responses.description: The voter's free-text responses to the poll's comment prompts. Allowed regardless of whether abstain is true — an abstaining voter skips the ballot but may still comment. Each prompt_id must match one of the poll's comment prompts and must not repeat; each comment_text is required (cannot be empty after trimming) and is rejected with a 400 if longer than 5000 characters. Optional; only meaningful if the poll has poll_comment_prompts.

Allowed regardless of whether abstain is true — an abstaining voter skips the ballot but may still comment. Each prompt_id must match one of the poll's comment prompts and must not repeat; each comment_text is required (cannot be empty after trimming) and is rejected with a 400 if longer than 5000 characters.
